title: Financial Sector Playbook
institution: Australian National Office of Cyber Security
scope: National-level coordination and consequence management; not a prescriptive technical SOC response workflow.

source.page_or_section: Initial response; Assess consequences; Categorise incident; Coordinated response; Post coordinated response
source.license_or_reuse: Check official terms; retain OFFICIAL marking and attribution.

prerequisites.requirement: Impacted entity reports incident to ASD before notifying NOCS

steps.description: Impacted entity reports the cyber incident to ASD before notifying NOCS.

source_anchor.section: Initial response — Notification of an incident
source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Impacted entities should report cyber incidents to ASD before notifying the NOCS.

steps.activity: Notify NOCS and seek coordination support
steps.description: Notify NOCS through an appropriate channel to seek whole-of-government coordination and consequence-management support.
steps.condition: Where NOCS coordination or consequence-management support is sought or relevant.

source_anchor.section: Initial response — Notification of an incident
source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Directly emailing NOCS.Response@homeaffairs.gov.au is the most effective way to ensure the NOCS is aware of an incident.

normalization_notes: NOCS engagement is described as voluntary; do not score non-engagement as an automatic SOC procedural failure.

steps.description: Assess potential impacts including safety, government, critical infrastructure, sector, financial stability, customer trust, and sensitive information exposure.
steps.actor_role: NOCS with impacted entity and stakeholders

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: The NOCS will assess potential consequences.

steps.activity: Categorise incident and determine coordination level
steps.description: Categorise incident severity and complexity using national thresholds and relevant impact considerations.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: The NOCS will categorise the incident on the following scale.

normalization_notes: Decision thresholds should be extracted from the full document and reviewed by a subject-matter reviewer.

steps.description: Establish shared situational awareness and, where appropriate, convene relevant working groups for technical, sectoral, identity, data, or communications issues.
steps.condition: Where the incident requires coordinated consequence management.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: The NOCS may establish working groups based on the specific nature of the incident.

normalization_notes: Working groups are examples and are not all mandatory for every incident.

steps.activity: Maintain coordinated response and situational updates
steps.description: Maintain coordination at a cadence appropriate to the level of response and stakeholder needs.
steps.condition: While coordinated consequence management remains necessary.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: The meetings will be maintained at a cadence appropriate to the level of coordination and communication required.

steps.activity: Stand down coordinated response and capture lessons learned
steps.description: Cease coordination when no longer required and consider a post-incident review and lessons learned.
steps.actor_role: NOCS with impacted entity and stakeholders

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: The NOCS will cease coordination and consequence management activities when a coordinated approach is no longer required.
